Level 17 Age-Composition Residual Diagnostics
=============================================

Interpretation
--------------
Residuals are observed minus predicted age-composition proportions after
propagating the fitted initial numbers and recruitment deviations. Large
fleet/year/age patterns indicate where the age-composition likelihood is
driving compensation through recruitment, initial numbers, or selectivity.
